Create an IR vector-literal node (mutate()/transmute() only)

Source: R/ir.R
ir_vec.Rd

A whole-dot constant vector (mutate(y = 1:5)): its length is the table's row count (or the call is an error), so it is uploaded as a column at lowering time (lower_mutate()), never evaluated by the GPU expression engine. Only ever the top node of a mutate expression record.

Usage

ir_vec(value, type, quo, name, loss = NULL)

Arguments

value

Atomic vector (names stripped), length != 1

type

GPU type string

quo

The named quosure of the dot, used to raise dplyr's own error when the length doesn't fit

name

Output column name

loss

What the upload would change in a Date/POSIXct value (timestamp_vector_loss()), or NULL (any other vector). The caller that records it also warns for it when the call is made, so it is marked warned: lower_mutate() mutes the upload's own warning for such a vector only (a plan would repeat it at every run).

Value

A cuplyr_ir_vec node
